Magnificent home located in the desirable subdivision "The Greens of Woodbury". The circular paver driveway pulls you up to this unique property. Double doors lead into the large two story foyer with marble flooring,wrought iron staircase & open floor plan. The sunken living room & family room with fireplace,have windows throughout allowing natural light to fill the space. The gourmet kitchen will satisfy the fussiest chef with granite counter tops,custom cabinetry & stainless steel appliances. There is also a bedroom with full bathroom (au pair suite) & an office with fireplace on the first floor. Front & back staircases lead to the second floor. Master bedroom with private balcony,fireplace & walk in closets. The large master bath offers a steam shower & whirlpool tub. Three additional bedrooms, two more full bathrooms & laundry room complete the second floor. The lower level of the home has an additional 2200 sq.feet of living space. Property backs to forever green space.
